shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 2 'form|input|select|switch|checkbox|avatar|upload' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar FilePreview ThemeProvider"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar FilePreview ThemeProvider && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(README\\.md|docs/INDEX\\.md|TextInput.*\\.d\\.ts|Select.*\\.d\\.ts|Switch.*\\.d\\.ts|Checkbox.*\\.d\\.ts|Avatar.*\\.d\\.ts|Button.*\\.d\\.ts|Text.*\\.d\\.ts)' | head -100 && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|styles.css|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/Select.d.ts && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -n 'interface ControlProps|type ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab/FileDropZone && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab/FileDropZone/parts/FileDropZone.Button.d.ts && rg -n -C 3 'FileDropZone' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '20,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '/lab/index\\.d\\.ts"'$|/components/index'"\\.d\\.ts"'$'"' | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-color-base-simple-hover|--g-color-text-hint|--g-color-text-positive|--g-color-base-positive' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | head -20 && npm run build && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -type f -delete && rmdir dist && git diff --stat && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -maxdepth 3 -type f -o -type d | head -40 && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir dist/assets dist && git diff --stat && git status --short'
